== History ==

Founded in 1998 (a lucky guess) by [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[DjHemuli]] and was a tf-clan for a couple of years. It was dead and buried until NQR Season 6 mipa resurrected the clan as a dm-clan asking hafog to be alongside and leave the glorious NEATMEAT.
